title: Custom domain: add, verify, TLS ask
caption: DNS verification by the worker through public resolvers, then Caddy's on-demand TLS gate. Requires FEATURE_CUSTOM_DOMAINS and a plan with customDomains > 0.

steps.label: tenant_domains pending, verification_token, deadline now + 72 h; audit
records: TXT _velexis.<host>, CNAME → <key>.ota.example.com (or A/AAAA to STOREFRONT_IPV4/6)
TXT and CNAME or A/AAAA (5 s per resolver)
verified (or failed after 72 h); audit; e-mail domain.verified / domain.failed
vx:invalidate domain (OTA backend and TLS ask forget the host)
syntax check → Redis tlsask:<host> (positive, 60 s) → in-process refusal LRU → one DB lookup
200 (Caddy may issue) / 404 for anything else, malformed hosts included
daily domains.tls_probe → tls_status issued/failed/expired; domains.recheck_verified (3 failures → failed)
